weekend_race.race_comments: Kyle Larson won the YellaWood 500 at Talladega Superspeedway, his 35th NASCAR Cup Series victory. Prior to the green flag to start the race, the following cars dropped to the rear of the field for the reasons indicated: Nos. 41, 47 (unapproved adjustments); No. 10 (inspection penalty).
